rationale: Price has ground steadily higher over the last several candles and is now trading above both the 5-min VWAP ($51.10) and the 9-EMA ($51.12), reversing the key structural conditions that underpinned the short entry. Volume is collapsing on this upward drift (14,759 → 1,655), which removes the "heavy supply" argument, and with ATR at only $0.03 the current adverse move represents multiple ATRs against us, leaving little cushion before the $51.25 invalidation level. The original thesis is no longer supported by price structure, so closing for a minimal loss is preferable to waiting for the stop to be hit.
